headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Grant Taylor earning the win. The Pittsburgh Pirates also secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, 11-7, behind a strong performance from their offense. The Detroit Tigers took down the New York Yankees 7-3, with Casey Mize pitching 7.0 innings and Amed Rosario leading the Tigers' offense with a home run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Miami Marlins right-handed pitcher Anthony Bender, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shin stress reaction. Other notable injuries include Houston Astros shortstop Jeremy Peña, who is on the 10-day injured list with a left calf strain, and Seattle Mariners designated hitter Rob Refsnyder, who is on the 10-day injured list with right knee inflammation.

The Seattle Mariners made a notable roster move, acquiring first baseman Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Owen Carapellotti. The Chicago Cubs acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for third baseman Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured an 8-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Grant Taylor earning the win.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 11-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 11-7. Brandon Marsh led the Phillies' offense with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Casey Mize earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs. Amed Rosario led the Tigers' offense with a home run, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets lost to the Toronto Blue Jays 2-1 in a close game. Francisco Lindor led the Mets' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Marlins RHP Anthony Bender Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-handed pitcher Anthony Bender has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shin stress reaction.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners after being traded from the Giants.
